in_marathi.name: Jairam
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Victory over Rama
in_marathi.long_meaning: Jairam हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Jai (victory) + Rama (god): A name signifying victory over the god Rama, often used in Hindu mythology for characters who have triumphed over adversity.

in_bengali.name: Jairam

in_bengali.long_meaning: Jairam একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Jai (victory) + Rama (god): A name signifying victory over the god Rama, often used in Hindu mythology for characters who have triumphed over adversity.
